hokuriku-alps.scenery: Clear days year-round. The Northern Alps typically carry snow from November to May.

sagano-gorge.scenery: Cherry blossoms in early April and autumn leaves from mid-November to early December.

joetsu-snow.scenery: Clear days year-round. The Echigo mountains typically carry snow from November to May.

tohoku-iwate.scenery: Clear days. The mountain peaks typically carry snow from November to May.

kurobe-gorge.scenery: Fresh greenery in May and June, and autumn leaves from late October to mid-November.

gono-coast.scenery: Coastal views year-round, with sunset views on some afternoon services.
